title: Make CanonicalJsonWriter escape all JSON control characters
description: Council serialization review found a reader/writer contract mismatch. MiniJsonReader now rejects raw characters below U+0020 inside JSON strings, but CanonicalJsonWriter.Escape only emits named escapes for newline, carriage return, and tab; the default branch appends other control characters unchanged. Authored strings containing NUL, backspace-like controls, or other U+0000..U+001F values can therefore be serialized as invalid JSON. Harden Escape to emit valid JSON unicode escapes for all remaining control characters and add round-trip regressions. Keep the existing named escapes for readability and preserve byte-stable canonical output for normal DNA. Parent owner: TSK-0136 parser/grammar hardening. Unity execution is required before closure.
